messages:
Priya (Hiring Manager): Candidate accepted verbally. Need unusual routing: wants start 2025-01-20 (earlier than posted), 26 days PTO (local law), and a 6,500 EUR sign-on to cover notice pay. Also small relocation support 1,500 EUR. Can we approve?
Ben (Recruiter): tagging @Ravi and @Aisha. Role L4, base 145k EUR equivalent. Will draft offer once we have approval path.
Aisha (Finance): Quick: sign-on 6.5k > threshold 5k so needs director signoff. Cost center CODE-59012. Payroll treatment? I'll check.
Ravi (People Ops): Routing rules: sign-on >5k escalates to People Ops Director + Finance ack. Localized PTO different from posting also flags for director. Submit business justification here.
Priya (Hiring Manager): Business note: critical sprint in Feb; earlier start required. Manager cannot move base comp. Candidate insists on 26 days.
Ben (Recruiter): Offer snapshot:
```
Base: 145000 EUR
Equity: 0.45%
Sign-on: 6500 EUR one-time
Relocation: 1500 EUR one-time
PTO: 26 days (local statutory)
Start: 2025-01-20
```
Nora (People Ops Director): I can approve the PTO & 6.5k sign-on if Finance confirms budget and payroll confirms tax handling (no gross-up). Approve contingent on CODE-59012 chargeback and legal loop if cross-border.
Aisha (Finance): Confirmed cost center CODE-59012 approved. Payroll: sign-on is taxable, no gross-up automatically. If manager requests gross-up, manager must cover extra.
Priya (Hiring Manager): OK no gross-up. Ben please include conditional language: "Offer contingent on payroll tax confirmation".
offer-bot: Offer created (draft) REQ-59012 link: https://redwood.example/offers/REQ-59012
Ben (Recruiter): Pushing verbal with conditional language now. Candidate prefers quick turnaround.
Ravi (People Ops): Noting exception EX-2025-017 in tracker. After candidate signs, Ops will produce final approval memo for payroll.
Nora (People Ops Director): Approved-in-principle. Follow-ups: payroll confirmation doc, legal if needed, final memo after acceptance.
